name: Tahini Sauce
siboNotes: Pure tahini is SIBO-friendly as it's made from sesame seeds. Check ingredients for added garlic or onion in commercial varieties.
preparationTips: Make your own with pure sesame paste and lemon juice
Thin with water or olive oil for desired consistency
Add fresh herbs like parsley or chives instead of garlic
Store homemade tahini sauce in refrigerator for up to one week
